Sales snippets / customer quotes:
- "We need reliable streaming for agent UX — stalls kill adoption."

PoC success criteria (customer-defined):
- Streaming 95th percentile latency < 200ms for token delivery across tool-calls under expected load (10 concurrent agents per region).
- Verified PII redaction / ability to opt-out logging for sensitive sessions.
- Round-trip tool-call latency (invoke + response) < 350ms for common ops.
- Demo of fallback routing to smaller model when hosted capacity constrained.

Risks: Mid-market legal wants explicit retention controls and clear documentation on what is processed in logs. They will escalate to procurement if SOC2 report not provided.

Recommended Redwood moves:
- Run controlled PoC day with synthetic workload mimicking 10 concurrent agents and tool calls; capture 50k sample tokens for latency histogram.
- Produce short log-redaction proof-of-concept and one-page summary for their security team.
- Prepare draft term sheet for Dedicated migration path and pricing scenarios.
